login.title: Sign in
login.connectHint: Sign in, and paperjam will ask what this application may do.

setup.title: Set up paperjam
setup.hint: Create the administrator account. The setup code is printed in the server log: run `docker logs paperjam`, or open the container log in your host.

pages.archiveDescription: Find any document, value or clause in seconds.
pages.uploadDescription: Drop files in. paperjam will read and organize them.
pages.taxonomyDescription: Keep people, organizations and tags tidy.
pages.trashDescription: Recently removed documents stay here until you permanently delete them.
pages.settingsDescription: Manage users, access tokens and your archive preferences.

archive.title: Archive
archive.syntaxDescription: Combine free text and filters in one query.
archive.syntaxHint: Pick an example to drop it into the search field, edit it there and search.
archive.syntaxHas: has this filled in: attention, expiring, tags, people, summary, type, from
archive.selectHint: Select documents to act on them
archive.noMatchesDescription: Try fewer words or remove a filter from the query.
archive.noMatchesWordsDescription: Try other words or a shorter query.
archive.partialNote: Nothing matched the whole query — here are matches for some of the words.
archive.emptyDescription: Add the first document and paperjam will make it searchable.
archive.documentDescription: The document workspace is ready for the next build stage.

document.shareLead: The link opens a page with the document: its pages, a download button and, if you like, the extracted details. No sign-in needed.
document.shareDetailsOn: The summary, fields and organizations are on the page. The title, type and date always are.
document.shareDetailsOff: Only the pages, title, type and date.

failureReasons.pdf_corrupt: The PDF is damaged or will not open. Check the file and upload it again.
failureReasons.pdf_encrypted: The PDF is password-protected. Remove the password and upload it again.
failureReasons.image_corrupt: The image is damaged or cannot be read. Upload the file again.
failureReasons.image_too_large: The image is too large to process. Make it smaller and upload it again.
failureReasons.heic_unsupported: HEIC files are not supported on this server. Save the photo as JPEG or PNG and upload it again.
failureReasons.ocr_failed: The text on the scan could not be recognised. Try reprocessing the document.
failureReasons.ocr_timeout: Text recognition took too long. Run processing again.
failureReasons.worker_failed: Processing was interrupted on the server. Run it again.
failureReasons.render_failed: The pages could not be prepared for viewing. Run processing again.
failureReasons.processing_failed: Processing failed. Run it again or check the file.
failureReasons.llm_failed: The AI processing step did not finish. Run processing again.
failureReasons.file_too_large: The file is too large. Upload a smaller file.
failureReasons.unknown: Processing failed. Try running it again.

document.imageUnavailable: The page preview is not available yet.
document.noPreviewFailed: No preview: the file could not be read.
document.noText: No text has been extracted from this page.
document.title: Title
document.createFailed: Could not create it. Try again.
document.summaryPlaceholder: A short note about this document
document.localOnlyDescription: Future processing stays local. Existing data is not sent anywhere by this setting.

attentionFlags.missing_fields: Some expected fields are missing. Check the document before relying on it.
attentionFlags.mrz_mismatch: The passport's machine-readable zone does not match the extracted values. Compare the fields with the scan and fix the wrong ones.
attentionFlags.checksum_failed: A number fails its check digit, so it was probably misread. Check it against the scan and fix it; editing the field clears this warning.
attentionFlags.ocr_llm_disagree: A number from the AI extraction does not appear in the recognized text, so it may be misread. Check it against the scan and fix it; editing the field clears this warning.
attentionFlags.illegible: Something on the page could not be read; the text keeps [illegible] markers in those places. Compare the scan and fill in what is missing.
attentionFlags.llm_failed: The AI step failed, so only the text and machine-readable zone data were used. Reprocess the document to try again.
attentionFlags.llm_budget: AI processing was skipped because the monthly spending limit was reached. Reprocess the document after the limit resets.
attentionFlags.processing_failed: Processing failed, so the document may be incomplete. Reprocess it or check the scan.

provenanceDescription.manual: Confirmed or edited by a person

document.showOriginal: Show the pages as scanned (before cleaning)

fieldIssues.mrz_mismatch: Differs from the machine-readable zone. Check it against the scan, then fix or confirm it.
fieldIssues.ocr_llm_disagree: This number is not in the recognized text of the page. Check it against the scan, then fix or confirm it.
fieldIssues.checksum_failed: The check digit does not match. Check it against the scan, then fix or confirm it.

upload.title: Add documents
upload.intro: Add PDFs, photos or text files. paperjam reads them and makes them searchable.
upload.dropDescription: or choose several files from your device
upload.formats: PDF, JPEG, PNG, WebP, TIFF, HEIC, TXT or Markdown
upload.scanTitle: A scan reads better than a photo
upload.scanHint: Use your device's document scanner, or photograph the page flat and in good light.
upload.localOnlyDescription: Text is read here and never sent to outside services.
upload.localOnlyBatchNote: Applies to every file below unless you change it for a single file.
upload.ready: Added — ready to read and search
upload.failed: Not added. Open the document for details.
upload.duplicate: This exact file is already in your archive.
upload.prefillHint: Applies to every file that has not been sent yet. What you choose here is kept when the document is read.
upload.prefillNoPeople: No people yet — add them in People & organizations.
upload.privacyLocal: This file: processed on this server only

taxonomy.title: People & organizations
taxonomy.intro: People, organizations and tags linked to every document.

empty.people: No people yet. Add someone who appears in your documents.
empty.correspondents: No organizations yet. Add one that appears in your documents.
empty.tags: No tags yet. Add one for a theme you search for often.
empty.types: No document types yet. Create one to define its structured fields.

taxonomy.unsavedDescription: Your edits have not been saved. Stay here to save them, or discard them and continue.
taxonomy.name: Name
taxonomy.aliasesDescription: Other spellings help extraction and search recognize the same record under different names.
taxonomy.mergeDescription: Move all documents and other spellings into this card, and delete the selected record.
taxonomy.mergeConfirm: Merge {{source}} into {{target}}? All document references will move, and {{source}} will be removed. This cannot be undone.
taxonomy.noDuplicates: There are no other records to merge.
taxonomy.deletePersonDescription: Remove this record from the directory. Documents will stay in the archive without this link.
taxonomy.deletePersonConfirm: Delete “{{name}}”? This removes the record from the directory and unlinks documents.
taxonomy.deleteCorrespondentDescription: Remove this record from the directory. Documents will stay in the archive without this link.
taxonomy.deleteCorrespondentConfirm: Delete “{{name}}”? This removes the record from the directory and unlinks documents.
taxonomy.deleteTagDescription: The tag is removed from every document. The documents themselves stay in the archive.
taxonomy.deleteTagConfirm: Delete “{{name}}”? It will be removed from {{count}} document(s). This cannot be undone.
taxonomy.fieldsDescription: These values become searchable on documents of this type. Labels are shown in the reader's language.
taxonomy.typeSaveHint: Removing a field hides it on future edits; values already stored in documents are preserved.
taxonomy.relinkHint: Documents are matched by name and other spellings automatically. Add another spelling if a document was missed.

documentTypes.title: Document types
documentTypes.description: Kinds of documents and the fields filled in for each.
documentTypes.emptyUsed: No document types are in use yet.

trash.title: Trash
trash.intro: Removed documents stay available here until you choose to delete them permanently.
trash.notice: Permanent deletion removes the original file, extracted text and metadata. It cannot be undone.
trash.emptyDescription: Documents you remove from the archive will appear here.
trash.purgeConfirm: The original file and all extracted data will be removed. This cannot be undone.
trash.emptyConfirm_one: Permanently delete the document in the trash? This cannot be undone.
trash.emptyConfirm_other: Permanently delete all {{count}} documents in the trash? This cannot be undone.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Your account, how documents are processed, and who and what can reach the archive.
settings.disableUserConfirm: Disable {{name}}? They will be signed out and unable to log in until re-enabled.
settings.deleteUserConfirm: Delete {{name}}? The account, its sessions, API tokens and passkeys will be permanently removed. Documents stay in the archive.
settings.passwordDescription: Change the password you sign in with. Other active sessions are signed out.
settings.tokensDescription: For the CLI, MCP and other API clients.
settings.secretDescription: This is the only time the full token will be shown.
settings.revokeConfirm: Revoke {{name}}? Clients using this token will immediately lose access.
settings.languageDescription: Titles and summaries of the documents you add are written in this language.
settings.calendarDescription: Due and renewal dates of your documents, as a calendar you subscribe to. It carries only titles and dates, never document values. Documents processed on this server only are left out.
settings.calendarRotateConfirm: The current link stops working at once. Subscribe again with the new one.
settings.calendarRevokeConfirm: Calendars subscribed to this link will stop updating.
settings.calendarLinkDescription: Subscribe to it in your calendar app. It is shown only now; make a new link if you lose it.
settings.calendarLead_one: A renewal reminder is added {{count}} day before each due date.
settings.calendarLead_other: A renewal reminder is added {{count}} days before each due date.
settings.calendarLeadAdminHint: Days before a due date to schedule the reminder (0 for the due date itself, up to 3650).
settings.calendarHelp: Google Calendar fetches the link from Google's servers, so it cannot reach a server that is open only over a VPN. Apple Calendar fetches it from your device and can.
settings.passkeysDescription: Sign in without a password. API tokens and MCP clients are not affected.
settings.passkeysUnavailable: To use passkeys, set PAPERJAM_PUBLIC_URL to the address you open paperjam at (https://…).
settings.removePasskeyConfirm: Remove {{name}}? You will no longer be able to sign in with it. The password keeps working.
settings.connectionsDescription: Apps you let in through OAuth, such as Claude. Disconnecting ends their access at once.
settings.disconnectConfirm: {{name}} will lose access to the archive. Connecting it again asks for your consent again.
settings.emailIntakeDescription: Forward receipts, bills, and PDFs to a dedicated address to add them to the archive automatically.
settings.emailEnabledHint: Turn off to pause email ingestion without revoking your secret.
settings.emailSecretRequiredHint: Generate a secret first before enabling email intake.
settings.emailSecretDescription: This is the only time the full secret is shown. Paste it into your email worker's EMAIL_SECRET variable.
settings.emailRotateConfirm: The current secret stops working immediately. Update EMAIL_SECRET in your email worker with the new value.
settings.emailRevokeConfirm: Email intake will be disabled and requests using this secret will be rejected.
settings.emailWorkerIntro: Set these variables in your Cloudflare Email Worker:
settings.emailWorkerVarUrl: Base URL of your paperjam instance (for example, https://archive.example.com).
settings.emailWorkerVarSecret: The email intake secret shown when generated above.
settings.emailWorkerVarSenders: Optional comma-separated sender list checked by the Worker before forwarding.
settings.emailWorkerEndpointNote: The Worker sends raw emails with Bearer authorization to
settings.emailAllowedSendersHint: One email address or @domain per line, or separated by commas.
settings.emailAllowedSendersEmptyNote: Empty list: any sender reaching this endpoint is accepted (the secret header is still required).
settings.emailBodyFallback: Save email body when there are no attachments
settings.emailBodyFallbackDescription: Archives the message text itself when an email arrives without PDF, image, or document attachments.
settings.emailLocalOnlyDescription: Never sends emailed attachments or message text to external AI services.
settings.llmUsageNotConfigured: LLM enrichment is not configured yet. Add an API key below to enable AI classification and field extraction.
settings.llmUsagePaused: LLM enrichment is paused. Documents are processed locally only.
settings.llmDescription: Configure the language model used for document classification, structured field extraction, and summaries.
settings.llmEnabledHint: Turn off to pause external AI calls across the archive without removing your API key.
settings.llmApiKeyConfiguredPlaceholder: Leave blank to keep the current key
settings.llmHandwritingHint: Uses the handwriting vision model when local OCR encounters handwritten text.
settings.llmCreateTagsHint: Allow the model to create new tags automatically when none of the existing ones fit.
settings.llmAllowedModelsHint: Comma or newline separated. Leave empty for automatic selection.
settings.llmPricesHint: Optional overrides in model=input:output format (USD per million tokens, comma-separated).
settings.llmResetTitle: Reset LLM settings to environment defaults?
settings.llmResetConfirm: Removes saved database overrides and the encrypted API key. Settings revert to the environment configuration.
settings.inboxDescription: Automatically import documents dropped into the server's watched directory.
settings.inboxUnconfiguredDescription: Mount a host directory and set PAPERJAM_INBOX_DIR in your environment to import files placed in that folder automatically.
settings.inboxPausedHint: Temporarily stop importing new files from the watched folder without unmounting it.
